--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -8.5000f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float rate = 45; // compare steps per second @tune
  static float hold = 1.5; // seconds to rest on the sorted bars @tune
  static float period, cycle, steps; // seconds per cycle; shuffle index; compares done so far
  static float tmp; // swap scratch
  static float x, h, s; // bar center x, bar height, palette mix
  static float cur; // bar index under the compare marker

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  // Bubble sort, scrubbed by t. A[0..15] holds 16 bar heights; the nested
  // loops below are the classic compare-and-swap, but each compare only
  // runs once enough time has passed (its overall index p*15 + j must stay
  // under steps). Every frame re-seeds and re-sorts from scratch, so the
  // bars freeze mid-algorithm at exactly floor(steps) compares -- drag the
  // time slider or replay to scrub the sort.
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  period = 225/rate + hold;
  cycle = floor(t/period);
  steps = fmod(t, period)*rate;
  // A fresh deterministic shuffle each cycle
  for(i, 0, 16) {
    A[i] = rand(i, cycle);
  }
  // Pass p bubbles the largest unsorted value to the right
  for(p, 0, 15) {
    for(j, 0, 15) {
      if(p*15 + j < steps && A[j] > A[j+1]) {
        tmp = A[j];
        A[j] = A[j+1];
        A[j+1] = tmp;
      }
    }
  }
  // Bars: height and color both follow the value, so sorted reads as a
  // staircase with a smooth left-to-right gradient
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    for(i, 0, 16) {
      s = A[i];
      glColor3f(0.98 - 0.62*s, 0.46 + 0.24*s, 0.36 + 0.62*s); // CORAL -> AZURE
      x = (i - 7.5)*0.42;
      h = 0.3 + 2.4*s;
      glVertex3f(x - 0.15, -1.5, 0);
      glVertex3f(x + 0.15, -1.5, 0);
      glVertex3f(x + 0.15, -1.5 + h, 0);
      glVertex3f(x - 0.15, -1.5 + h, 0);
    }
  glEnd();
  if(steps < 225) {
    // Two dots mark the pair the sort is comparing right now
    cur = fmod(floor(steps), 15);
    glPointSize(7);
    glColor3f(0.98, 0.76, 0.36);
    glBegin(GL_POINTS);
      glVertex3f((cur - 7.5)*0.42, -1.75, 0);
      glVertex3f((cur - 6.5)*0.42, -1.75, 0);
    glEnd();
    glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
    glRasterPos3f(-3.4, 1.7, 0);
    label("pass %f of 15", floor(steps/15) + 1);
  } else {
    glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
    glRasterPos3f(-3.4, 1.7, 0);
    label("sorted");
  }
